content: वैवस्वतः [विवस्वतोऽपत्यम् अण्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the seventh Manu who is supposed to preside over the present age; see under Manu; वैवस्वतो मनुर्नाम माननीयो मनीषिणाम् <ls>R. 1. 11</ls>; <ls>U. 6. 18</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Yama; यानं सस्मार कौबेरं वैवस्वतजिगीषया <ls>R. 15. 45</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Agni. .²4 One of the eleven Rudras. .²5 The planet Saturn. .{@-तम्@} The present age or Manvantara, as presided over by Manu Vaivasvata or the seventh Manu.
